title: Histone extraction for mass spectrometry-based analysis of Aspergillus
author: Xin Zhang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.btpinmke
materials: Freeze germinated spores in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Harvest and prepare spore suspension
steps.instruction: Harvest fungal spores from 4‑ or 5‑day‑old sporulating plates with a spreader into 12.5 mL ice‑cold ACES buffer; discard the supernatant and resuspend spores in 25 mL ice‑cold ACES buffer; then resuspend in 10 mL ice‑cold ACES buffer and count the concentration with a hemacytometer or spore counter (target ≈1 × 10⁷ spores / mL).

steps.title: Inoculate liquid culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate 50 mL liquid medium in a 250 mL flask with 1 – 10 × 10⁷ spores and incubate at 30 °C, 200 rpm for 16 hours.

steps.title: Collect germinated spores
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the germinated spores at 4,000 × g for 10 minutes and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend in NaCl
steps.instruction: Resuspend the germinated spore pellet in 25 mL 0.8 M NaCl.

steps.title: High‑Triton lysis
steps.instruction: Resuspend 100 mg of the ground sample in 1 mL lysis buffer containing 1×PBS, 0.5 mM PMSF, 5 µM leupeptin, 5 µM aprotinin, 5 mM Na‑butyrate, and 10 % Triton X‑100.

steps.title: Low‑Triton extraction
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL lysis buffer (1×PBS, 0.5 mM PMSF, 5 µM leupeptin, 5 µM aprotinin, 5 mM Na‑butyrate, 1 % Triton X‑100), vortex, and incubate on an orbital shaker at 4 °C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3,250 × g for 30 minutes at 4 °C and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: PBS wash
steps.instruction: Add 9 mL ice‑cold PBS buffer and vortex to mix.

steps.title: Acid extraction
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 2 mL 0.4 N H₂SO₄ and incubate on an orbital shaker at 4 °C for 4 hours.

steps.title: Collect soluble histones
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 16,000 × g for 10 minutes at 4 °C; retain the supernatant that contains soluble core histone proteins.

steps.title: Acetone precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 4 volumes of acetone to the supernatant and store at –20 °C overnight to precipitate histone proteins.

steps.title: Pellet and dissolve histones
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 6,000 × g for 25 minutes at 4 °C, discard the supernatant, and dissolve the protein pellet in 100 µL water.

steps.title: Quantify protein
steps.instruction: Measure protein concentration using the Bradford Protein Assay.

steps.title: Sonicate protein solution
steps.instruction: Sonicate for 30 seconds, repeat 10 times with a 30‑second break between each sonication.

steps.title: Assess protein quality
steps.instruction: Analyze the protein sample by 16 % SDS‑PAGE.
